borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
decision_conditions: <p>The proposed development would result in a loss of generous family-size single dwellinghouse, which is a housing type in high demand within the Borough and of which local policies seek to preserve. While it would provide a dwelling in the form of an HMO, it fails to demonstrate that this meets an identified need, and further would not provide an adequate quality of accommodation to support a high standard of living, as the internal space of the dwelling also does not comply with the minimum requirements set out in the NDSS and London Plan to support a 4-bedroom HMO. As such, the proposal is considered to have a detrimental impact on the borough's housing supply and is contrary to the following policies:</p><p>-&nbsp;National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (DLUHC, 2023);</p><p>- Technical Housing Standards (Nationally Described Space Standard) (DCLG, March 2015) (as amended);</p><p>- Policies D6 and H9 of the London Plan (March 2021);</p><p>- London Plan Guidance: Housing Design Standards (GLA, June 2023)</p><p>- Policy CC1 of the LBBD's Local Development Framework (LDF) Core Strategy (July 2010);</p><p>- Policies BP5 and BP6 of the LBBD's Local Development Framework (LDF) Borough Wide Development Plan Document (DPD) (March 2011) and</p><p>- Policy DMH5 of the LBBD's Draft Local Plan (Regulation 19 Submission Version, December 2021).</p>

<p><span class="ui-provider ed bro brp brq brr brs brt bru brv brw brx bry brz bsa bsb bsc bsd bse bsf bsg bsh bsi bsj bsk bsl bsm bsn bso bsp bsq bsr bss bst bsu bsv" dir="ltr">The proposed House in Multiple Occupation (HMO) is likely to result in an increased activity level and coming and goings to and from the site leading to additional levels of noise and disturbance at the property. This is considered to have a negative impact on neighbouring amenity in this street of family housing and in turn the health and wellbeing of neighbouring residents. As such the proposal is contrary to the following:</span></p><p><span class="ui-provider ed bro brp brq brr brs brt bru brv brw brx bry brz bsa bsb bsc bsd bse bsf bsg bsh bsi bsj bsk bsl bsm bsn bso bsp bsq bsr bss bst bsu bsv" dir="ltr">-&nbsp;National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) (DLUHC, 2023);</span></p><p><span class="ui-provider ed bro brp brq brr brs brt bru brv brw brx bry brz bsa bsb bsc bsd bse bsf bsg bsh bsi bsj bsk bsl bsm bsn bso bsp bsq bsr bss bst bsu bsv" dir="ltr">- Policies BP8 and BR13 of the LBBD's Local Development Framework (LDF) Borough Wide Development Plan Document (DPD) (March 2011);</span></p><p><span class="ui-provider ed bro brp brq brr brs brt bru brv brw brx bry brz bsa bsb bsc bsd bse bsf bsg bsh bsi bsj bsk bsl bsm bsn bso bsp bsq bsr bss bst bsu bsv" dir="ltr">- Policy DMSI3 of&nbsp;the LBBD’s Draft Local Plan: (Regulation 19 Submission Version, December 2021)<br></span><br></p>
